dedupe_keys.name: rhmz serbia current hydrological and meteorological data

description: The current data pages of the Republic Hydrometeorological Service of Serbia publish observations collected every day. Hydrological data covers water level, change and tendency of level, discharge, water temperature and ice for 54 reporting stations; meteorological data includes hourly temperature, pressure, humidity, wind and weather descriptions for Serbia, weather in Europe, upper-air soundings, radar images from the MRL-5 radar at Košutnjak and a local area weather radar in Belgrade, satellite images, automatic weather stations and groundwater reporting stations. The same site publishes forecasts, warnings and hydrological yearbooks of surface waters as PDF files (for example the 2014 yearbook). Access is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the current values are operational and not quality controlled, the pages are in Serbian Cyrillic, and longer series are in yearbooks, not downloadable tables. Coverage is Serbia. It supports flood exposure and emergency response analysis for bridges, flood defences, water intakes and hydropower on Serbian rivers; related records are the Srbijavode flood hazard and risk maps, the IMO Iceland hydrometric network and the LVĢMC Latvia hydrological forecasts.
